result.summary: Do not close the design gate: the required OC-4 regression makes the frozen RED declaration fail.

findings.title: OC-4 creates an undeclared failure under the required mutation
findings.body: OC-4 requires a whole-tree assertion that the pruned original's bytes are absent. The prescribed mutation copies every evicted original into quarantine/.pruned, so it necessarily fails OC-4 as well as OC-1. Executing the actual prune function and specified mutation against an in-memory filesystem confirmed both absence checks fail. scripts/red-proofs.js:1668-1670 rejects undeclared testCodeFailure results, but this contract permits only OC-1 and forbids widening expectRed. Consequently, an implementation satisfying both test contracts cannot pass the required RED lane; the earlier measurement predates OC-4.
findings.recommendation: Declare OC-4 as a second expected failure with its own one-element identity path and signal, update the exact-one acceptance requirement, and verify the mutation against all four new tests.

next_steps: Reconcile the RED declaration with OC-4 before dispatching implementation.
